I have implemented the changes for property-to-property comparisons in Cypher `WHERE` clauses and added unit tests in [`tests/test_cypher.c`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/tests/test_cypher.c). I am currently running the C test suite and will report the results once it completes.
I have implemented support for property-to-property comparisons in Cypher `WHERE` clauses:

### Summary of Changes
1. **Condition AST Model ([`src/cypher/cypher.h`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/src/cypher/cypher.h#L185-L200))**:
   - Added `rhs_variable` and `rhs_property` fields to [`cbm_condition_t`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/src/cypher/cypher.h#L185-L200) (and freed them in [`expr_free`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/src/cypher/cypher.c#L743-L780) and [`free_where`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/src/cypher/cypher.c#L1953-L1973)).
2. **WHERE Parser ([`src/cypher/cypher.c`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/src/cypher/cypher.c#L1011-L1122))**:
   - Extended [`parse_condition_expr`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/src/cypher/cypher.c#L1011-L1122) so that when the right-hand side of a comparison operator is an identifier (`variable` or `variable.property`), it populates `c.rhs_variable` and `c.rhs_property` while still rejecting unsupported RHS expressions (such as function calls `ident(...)` or list indexing `[...]`) with `expected value at pos N`.
3. **Evaluator & WITH Projection ([`src/cypher/cypher.c`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/src/cypher/cypher.c#L2354-L2555))**:
   - Extracted [`resolve_var_prop`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/src/cypher/cypher.c#L2356-L2381) to resolve both left-hand and right-hand variable/property references against the active binding (supporting node properties, edge properties, and `WITH` virtual bindings).
   - Updated [`eval_condition`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/src/cypher/cypher.c#L2437-L2525) and [`eval_expr`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/src/cypher/cypher.c#L2547-L2570) so unbound RHS variables during early single-node `WHERE` filtering defer filtering until relationship expansion binds the RHS variable, and evaluate via [`eval_comparison_op`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/src/cypher/cypher.c#L2391-L2434) (`=`, `<>`, `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`, etc.) once bound.
   - Updated [`execute_with_simple`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/src/cypher/cypher.c#L3742-L3771) and [`with_add_vbinding_var`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/src/cypher/cypher.c#L3659-L3666) so bare node variables carried through `WITH a, b` retain their node properties for post-`WITH` `WHERE` comparisons and `RETURN` projections.
4. **Unit Tests ([`tests/test_cypher.c`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/tests/test_cypher.c#L2524-L2690))**:
   - Added [`cypher_parse_where_prop_to_prop`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/tests/test_cypher.c#L2526-L2552), [`cypher_exec_where_prop_eq_prop`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/tests/test_cypher.c#L2597-L2613), [`cypher_exec_where_prop_neq_prop`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/tests/test_cypher.c#L2615-L2630), [`cypher_exec_where_prop_ordering`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/tests/test_cypher.c#L2632-L2660), and [`cypher_exec_with_where_prop_to_prop`](file:///Volumes/Projects/a4c/benchmarks/large-repo-comparison/results/2026-10-16-native-antigravity-gemini/repo/tests/test_cypher.c#L2662-L2678).
